args.value: Three rules make it deterministic, not vibes: (1) agents TRAVERSE approved nodes, humans AUTHOR/approve; (2) every node is typed + carries provenance (sourced|inferred|user-intent) and an honesty label (shipped|roadmap|inference); (3) the tree is the contract — advisor answers cite node IDs or say 'not in the approved tree'. One human gate: approval. Mirrors Faros's own policy+provenance+human-review governance.
